newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heidemij sees slight profit rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Heidemij sees slight profit rise in 1997.

text.p: Engineering consultancy Heidemij NV said on Wednesday it expected a slight increase in revenues and earnings for the whole of 1997.
Earlier on Wednesday Heidemij reported that its operating profit for the first quarter of 1997 rose to 8.4 million guilders from 7.6 million in the same period of 1996.
Heidemij said its prospects varied per geographical region.
In the Netherlands, Heidemij said it foresaw further growth of activities, notably in infrastructure.
In Germany and France circumstances would remain difficult in 1997, due to reduced government spending on infrastructure and environment, as these countries prepare for EMU.

Heidemij said its market share in new environmental markets in the U.S., such as the cleaning of lightly polluted company land and other voluntarily investments in environmental care, was growing, thus partly offsetting the reduction in traditional environmental markets.
Heidemij said it would also benefit from the growth in infrastructure investment in the U.S.
